name: status-review-dashboard
description: Create compact, source-linked status-review dashboards for project health, release readiness, workflow operations, learning progress, and periodic activity.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-based status reviews at a glance
interface.longDescription: Turn project, release, workflow, learning, or periodic activity evidence into a compact status-review dashboard with clear state, source links, and next actions. Render it interactively when the host supports that capability, or preserve the same hierarchy in Markdown.
defaultPrompt: Create a compact project health dashboard.
Review release readiness as an interactive dashboard.
Turn this week's work into an evidence-based dashboard.
